decisions.PASS: no configured blocker/warning observed. PASS is not a safety guarantee.
decisions.WARN: One or more configured Jepeta warning rules matched usable evidence.
decisions.BLOCK: One or more configured Jepeta blocking rules matched usable evidence.
decisions.NO_VERDICT: A required provider or signal is unusable, stale, invalid, unavailable or conflicting. A valid GoPlus response omitting only cannot_sell_all may still yield a verdict with UNKNOWN sellability and degraded evidence quality under V5 methodology 2.1.1.

freeVsPaid.free: Public V5 POST exact-token scan, V4 GET compatibility preview, plus public discovery risk feed.
freeVsPaid.paid: Human-readable report through Telegram Stars. ACP report contract and listed price are documented; the offering is listed on Virtuals ACP and paid fulfillment remains unverified.

acpAvailability.message: The offering is listed on Virtuals ACP. Paid fulfillment has not yet been verified. This website does not process ACP payments.

exampleResponse.note: Illustrative response generated from synthetic source inputs using the public v4 preview logic; values and timestamp are not a live scan of the example token.

limitations: Screening only; not a smart-contract audit, safety guarantee, price prediction, or investment recommendation.
Only Base ERC-20 contracts on chain 8453 are supported.

GoPlus remains required for the V4 and V5 critical security observations. V5 treats a valid GoPlus omission of cannot_sell_all as an unresolved evidence gap with degraded quality; provider failure or malformed security evidence still fails closed.
DEX Screener, Sourcify and direct Base on-chain evidence are optional in Stage 8; optional failure remains explicit.
Blockscout is isolated discovery context and GeckoTerminal remains disabled pending review.
The public risk feed contains published discovery signals only and is not a census of Base or all Jepeta scans.

eligibility: HIGH or MEDIUM public data quality
at least two non-null public evidence dimensions

answerPagePolicy.thinContentGuard: Unique authored answer and sections per question; no keyword-substitution pages.
answerPagePolicy.comparisonGuard: Describe documented scope and limitations without declaring a winner.

researchPolicy.deduplication: Latest usable observation per token per month.
researchPolicy.limitation: Published percentages describe Jepeta's observed usable sample and must not be generalized to the entire Base ecosystem.

pipeline.label: Raw Observation
pipeline.meaning: Provider or direct on-chain response is received through a governed adapter. Raw provider payloads are not public evidence.

pipeline.label: Normalized Evidence
pipeline.meaning: Provider-specific fields become provider-neutral Evidence Model observations with signal, value, source, status, observed_at, freshness and provenance.

pipeline.label: Conflict Detection
pipeline.meaning: Comparable normalized observations are compared deterministically. DISAGREE is preserved; no majority vote or implicit provider winner is used.

pipeline.label: Jepeta Rule
pipeline.meaning: Risk Engine v3 evaluates documented rules over normalized evidence only.

pipeline.label: Verdict
pipeline.meaning: Jepeta emits PASS, WARN or BLOCK only when required evidence is usable and no configured risk-signal conflict forces NO_VERDICT.

separation.providerObservation: What an upstream source or direct on-chain read returned.
separation.normalizedEvidence: Provider-neutral evidence after adapter validation and normalization.
separation.providerHealth: Availability/error state of each source; not itself a risk verdict.
separation.evidenceQuality: Completeness/freshness/usability of evidence; separate from risk.
separation.riskDecision: Configured Jepeta rule matches and deterministic score effects.
separation.finalVerdict: Jepeta-owned PASS/WARN/BLOCK decision, or NO_VERDICT when fail-closed gates prevent a decision.

rules.normalization_semantics: Normalized boolean; rule matches only when value is true.
rules.evidence_quality_effect: Required security evidence.
rules.failure_semantics: Required missing, UNKNOWN, UNAVAILABLE, PARTIAL, RATE_LIMITED, ERROR or expired evidence cannot produce PASS and yields NO_VERDICT.

rules.freshness_semantics: Expired normalized evidence is not usable as a fresh observation.

failureSemantics.required: Provider failure, missing or invalid required signals other than a valid GoPlus cannot_sell_all omission, stale evidence and unresolved conflicts yield NO_VERDICT. The scoped valid omission remains UNKNOWN and degrades quality; it is never replaced with false.
failureSemantics.optional: Optional source failure remains explicit in quality and provider health. Unconfirmed exact-token liquidity yields WARN with zero score delta; it is never treated as zero liquidity or a PASS observation.

conflictSemantics.riskSignalDisagreement: DISAGREE on a configured Risk Engine v3 signal yields NO_VERDICT.
conflictSemantics.winnerSelection: No provider winner is selected unless a documented rule explicitly says so; Stage 8 defines no such winner rule.

freshnessSemantics.sourceOfTruth: Normalized Evidence Model freshness metadata plus provider registry.

v5.active: public canonical default and explicit endpoint

methodologySummary: Versioned deterministic methodology for Jepeta Risk Engine v3: raw observations are normalized, compared for conflicts, evaluated by Jepeta rules, then mapped to a verdict.

sellabilityPolicyV5.explicitTrue: BLOCK through R3-BLOCK-CANNOT-SELL-ALL with unchanged score delta.
sellabilityPolicyV5.explicitFalse: Observed false; continue unchanged risk rules when other required evidence is usable.
sellabilityPolicyV5.validProviderOmission: UNKNOWN with reason PROVIDER_OMITTED_SIGNAL. A verdict may be issued with explicit degraded evidence quality, a zero-delta unmatched sellability trace, and no assertion of sellability.
sellabilityPolicyV5.providerFailure: NO_VERDICT for timeout, rate limit, partial, unavailable or error.
sellabilityPolicyV5.independentProbe: SHADOW_ONLY until semantic equivalence to the full-sale restriction predicate is demonstrated.
